name: Gan Open 2025
information: L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€. Merci de lire attentivement les **[conditions d'inscription](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GanOpen2025#61869-modalites-d-inscription-liste-d-attente-registration-conditions-waiting-list), la [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GanOpen2025#61873-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). ---- Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€. Please read the **[registration conditions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GanOpen2025#61869-modalites-d-inscription-liste-d-attente-registration-conditions-waiting-list), the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GanOpen2025#61873-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.
